player_signals.summary: Updated diagnosis Oct 19 (Eagles + agent joint statement): deep vein thrombosis and bilateral pulmonary emboli (blood clots in lungs). Initially superficial calf clot. Clinically stable, no significant functional limitations. Treatment: anticoagulation (blood thinners); no contact activities including football until off thinners. Prognosis very good, full recovery expected, no long-term effects anticipated. Media reports indicate expected to miss remainder of 2026 season (~3 months). Still on NFL IR.
